title: Minemon
description: Official Minemon server modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1, featuring Cobblemon, factions, guilds, economy systems, and exclusive events.
body:
**🌟 Minemon - Pokémon in Minecraft 🌟**

Experience the ultimate Pokémon adventure in Minecraft! The official modpack for the Minemon server, featuring Cobblemon, a faction system, guilds, an economy, and exclusive events.

**✨ Includes:**
- Full Cobblemon
- Faction and guild system
- Economy and jobs
- Events and tournaments
- Fully in Spanish

**🎮 Optimized for:** Minemon Server
**📦 Version:** Minecraft 1.21.1

🌐 **Store:** tienda.minemon.es
💬 Join our Spanish-speaking community and become the best Pokémon trainer.
